resources.string: What EDroid asks for and why

EDroid only asks for what an app store needs. Some permissions are granted when you install EDroid; others are asked the first time a feature needs them, and you can change them any time in system settings.
Granted when you install EDroid and never asked for. EDroid only talks to the F-Droid repository; it has no analytics or tracking.

string-array.name: permission_internet_uses
string-array.item: Download the APK files you choose to install

resources.string: Granted when you install EDroid and never asked for. The list of apps on your device never leaves it.

string-array.name: permission_query_packages_uses
string-array.item: Tell which repository apps are already installed, and at which version
Show Install, Update or Uninstall on each app

resources.string: Asked by Android the first time you install an app. Android requires it before any app other than the system store can install apps, and still asks you to confirm each install. Without it you can browse, but Install and Update won\'t work.

string-array.name: permission_install_uses
string-array.item: Install the apps you choose from the repository
Update installed apps to newer versions

resources.string: Granted when you install EDroid and never asked for. EDroid never removes an app on its own: Android always asks you to confirm.

string-array.name: permission_delete_uses
string-array.item: Open Android\'s uninstall dialog from the Uninstall button

resources.string: Optional, and only asked for on Android 13 and later, the first time you tap Install. If you decline, installs still work; just come back to EDroid to finish them.

string-array.name: permission_notifications_uses
string-array.item: Tell you a download is ready to install while EDroid is in the background
